column3: My father was a famous doctor who lived happily with his wife,
But one day!
A burglar broke into our estate...
...And killed them both.
I was left alone, in the darkness...
Only a single creature appeared before me, but when it did, I knew my purpose.
I knew I would dedicate my life to fighting crime across the city under my secret identity...
SAMSON: Terra, that's literally the plot of a superhero comic.
Try again.
TERRA: aw bitchtits i been found out
but das okay.
cuz they'll NEVER find me here!
SAMSON: What, exactly, are you doing?
TERRA: awwll set. les do dis.
M3G4T3RR4, JACK OFF! EXECUTE!\tts[MEGATERRA, JACK OFF! EXECUTE!]
CIEL: I... beg your pardon?
SAMSON: Please tell me she didn't just escape into that big-ass computer.
CIEL: All right.
She didn't just escape into that computer.
SAMSON: Thanks.
SAMSON: I guess it works like storing Pokémon in a PC.
...And it looks like it's waiting for a "Player 2".
\PN, I think that has to be you.
You know the most about the situation, and you should be strong enough to fight her.
We'll follow you if possible, but it looks like this console only accepts two "players".
Talk to me whenever you're ready and I'll see if I can get you in there.
CIEL: Honestly though, if it is true, what's a girl like her doing in Team Meteor?
CIEL: While I do understand we can't just set her free, I will miss her cacophonous babbling in some strange, dissolute way.
She was our friend after all.
I can hardly believe that all this time she was working for our enemies.
No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
AME: \PN?
Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
Anyway...
AME: You made it to the Agate Circus? Sounds like it's a mess up there.
As you might know, Agate Circus services three separate Leaders. So Samson is first?
All right. He's fresh into the ring as far as Leaders go, so I can't say too much, but I'll tell you what I know about the Big Top Arena.
There's actually two main parts to it. The first is Samson's ploy, the High Striker.
The entire ground is made of panels that trigger it.
They were originally set up for Terra, as any attack that hits the floor hard will activate it.
But since Fighting moves take strong power stances, they end up triggering the panels too. See if you can get a bonus from it as well!
Alternatively, you might use Ciel's type advantage part of the field against him.
Some Flying-type attacks like Acrobatics and Bounce can make an extra splash around the Big Top with Ciel's aerial scaffolding.
A few of those, and Samson should go down in no time!
Good luck!
AME: Glad you picked up. I heard from Cal about what's going on.
I never would have thought Terra of all people would be a Meteor.
I mean, I never liked her anyway, so whatever.
I patched into her computer after I heard there was something up with it, and I can see it reporting her presence.
I'm not going to question how she managed to enter a computer world at all; that girl already defies logic.
I'm running an analysis right now. Hold on, and I'll tell you what to expect.
The results are strange.
It looks like the computer environment is set up to simulate an old video game.
In this game, attacks are physical or special based on what type they are.
Plus, the Special Attack and Special Defense stats are treated as a single value-- it looks like it works off of whichever stat is higher.
Finally, the Dark-, Steel- and Fairy-types seem to have been erased.
This all sounds familiar, right?
Keep these things in mind when you're in there. I know you can do what's necessary.
AME: So you need to fight Ciel?
Right. This won't be the first time you've fought on this field, so try to keep in mind everything you used before against Samson.
Unlike Samson's all-out offense, Ciel plays more defensively.
Many of her Pokémon have bulky set-ups, so they can be hard to power down.
But, Ciel is a performer at heart, and it shows in her battles, as she prefers to use dancing and sound- based moves.
And being in an arena, it's the perfect place for those things to get her going.
If you can set up and knock her down before she even gets in the air, you should do well!
But if she gets her act in the air, it's gonna be a long way down for you.
CIEL: Shall we dance?
CIEL: Right, show me everything you've got!
CIEL: Take your time, darling. I want your best performance!
RINGMASTER: All right, that was very well done, both of you!
CIEL: Naturally~
RINGMASTER: BUT.
No more stunts like that in the future, Ciel.
CIEL: Who, me?
I haven't a clue what you might be referring to.
RINGMASTER: The only reason I went with it is because we ARE short on performances with Terra gone.
CIEL: Thank you for your benevolence and mercy, young master~
RINGMASTER: "Young master"?
Go back to sassing each other.
I've got a closing ceremony to do!
SAMSON: Nice.
CIEL: I don't want to hear it!
My battle was better than yours.
So ha-ha~
SAMSON: Whatever you say, lass.
I think we can agree that both of our battles beat getting lost in a digital void.
I'm not really in the mood to banter though, so I'm gonna go blow off some steam.
Ciao.
CIEL: Hmm...
I suppose you have business too, don't you?
It's been quiet here lately.
CIEL: But I suppose it's to be expected.
What is it they say?
It's lonely at the top.
...Or, perhaps,
They only say that because they've already pushed everyone who cared for them away.
Well, Samson is so easy to bully, one can hardly be blamed for it, right?
And that's kind of our thing.
Terra...
Well, she has her moments, I suppose.
When she isn't stabbing us in our proverbial backs, that is.
There was another, you know.
They came out here not long after I did, and brought their own act.
And I think they expected more from me than I could give.
It was my cousin.
But I was afraid that if I let the pieces of my old life trail behind me, they would drag me down.
I was, perhaps, callous.
I suddenly feel as if I owe them an apology.
Maybe I shall attempt to reach out to them...
CIEL: Ah, but enough of you lingering just to hear me drivel on.
You intend to go back to the city, don't you?
Best of luck, wherever you go, \PN.
SAMSON: I'm on cleaning duty for a month.
Trashed the changing room.
Had to.
At first it was just Ciel's cabinet.
Then it was Terra's.
Bunch of fucking rubber Torchic in there.
They scream bloody murder.
Laughed so hard I fell over and passed out.
That's one way to get caught red-handed.
Even when she's been gone for so long, that wench still causes trouble for me.
You know, she's the only reason I was in the Triumvirate in the first place.
I'd been in the Circus for a while.
My old man was a fan of corporal punishment.
I wasn't.
But eventually boys get bigger than their fathers.
That bit him in the ass.
Got kicked to the street; found a life here.
Then that chick showed up one day and insisted on being a lion tamer of all things.
We made her a clown.
She dyed her hair.
Could've just worn a wig, but, nope.
That would've been practical.
That ain't her style.
She always got on my nerves, and was all too happy to do so.
She knew I had eyes for Ciel.
With a lady like that, who can blame a man?
I think she started flirting with her just to make me jealous.
Eventually it came to a bet.
Six on six.
Winner asked her out first.
And if Terra had lost, she'd have left the Circus.
If I had lost, I would've done whatever she wanted.
She wanted me to register as a Leader with her.
Only got the reserve spot for my type, but that was enough to get us into some extra limelight for shows.
Enough to get us more time around Ciel.
And more rejections apiece.
But thinking about it...
I'm glad it didn't go down any other way.
I don't have a fucking clue what to do, \PN.
I learned from my old man that getting back at someone never makes anything better.
But I can't shake this anger.
It's quiet by now, but it's there.
It doesn't leave, no matter what I take it out on.
I can barely breathe,
Like a vat of lava being poured down my throat,
Fire in my fucking bloodstream,
Eventually it just settles into stone.
A weight in my core.
Hard to walk. Hard to think.
And I'm sure it's not half as bad as whatever's happened to Ciel.
SAMSON: If I stay around here, I'll break something, or someone.
See you around.
Yes
No
Ey, why you are leaving Circus! No, you cannot be leaving yet!
Why not stay with us for long time?!
Or at least give us money, no?
There are three mountains nearby: Ametrine, Celestinine and Citrine. \nWhich shall I hike today? I'll decide in a battle with you!
Hm. Better not go to Ametrine. I don't think I'm up to that after all.
Of the three, Ametrine is by far the largest. I'll save that for another day.
It's so cold and wet around Ametrine.\nI gotta find that Machine to get through it, but in the meantime, let's have a warm up!
That was a good warm up! Let's go!
Ametrine is basically a massive conglomeration of stone, ice, and water. It's a great challenge!
Huff... I need a break from hopping across all these rocks!
Although, I'll tell you what, I bet that I'm not half as beat up as that kid who was like thrown into the mountain.
He landed somewhere in the south part of the Route.
I hope he's all right.

AMARIA: Come here to lie to my face some more?
TITANIA: What do you even want me to say here?
AMARIA: I want you to tell me the truth!
TITANIA: What "truth"?
I don't know what it is you're expecting to hear.
AMARIA: Why don't we start with "Titawin"?
TITANIA: I have no idea what that even is.
AMARIA: I bet.
\PN knows what I'm getting at.
TITANIA: Literally, what are you talking about?
You're being ridiculous.
AMARIA: \PN, you know she's in the wrong here, don't you?!
AMARIA: See?!
You can lie all you want, but we both know all about your betrayal.
TITANIA: What are you hoping to accomplish by dragging a third party into this?
AMARIA: I'm trying to hold you accountable for this betrayal.
TITANIA: What "betrayal"?
AMARIA: We know you're working with Team Meteor.
TITANIA: ...Okay, there's been a misunderstanding.
I've been giving them false information to keep them from finding you.
If that's what this is all about, we can all relax and go home.
AMARIA: Then why all the secrecy?!
Why all the comments about lying--
The defensiveness, the cold silence--
I love you so much, and I would accept anything you ever shared with me--
So why don't you!?
AMARIA: ...Because you don't love me.
TITANIA: It's not that simple--
AMARIA: You don't love me the way I love you.
Tell me I'm wrong.
AMARIA: That's what I thought.
TITANIA: I care about you more than anyone else in the entire world.
AMARIA: But you don't love me.
You were only pretending to.
TITANIA: I couldn't stand the thought of you doing something--
Of you hurting yourself,
Just because I wasn't able to return your feelings properly.
If I had a choice, I would, in a heartbeat.
At the time-- when it first became official-- I thought,
I shouldn't let my own lack of emotions get in the way of your happiness.
I thought, if I stuck with you, and really devoted myself to you,
Maybe you'd get better,
Or maybe I would start to feel it properly.
I just had to keep things stable until then.
AMARIA: And I see that worked out great.
TITANIA: I wish it had.
I'm sorry.
AMARIA: I don't want you to apologize for your feelings, or lack thereof.
I want you to apologize for lying.
For years-- for all that is holy-- lying all of this time?
How many times have we kissed?
How many times were you doing that just for my sake?
TITANIA: ...I don't think you want me to answer that.
AMARIA: Right.
I bet.
And you assured me otherwise how many times?
All just out of what, pity?
TITANIA: Not pity.
I thought it was compassion--
But I know it was misguided.
AMARIA: You were my world.
I guess I was just your prison.
AMARIA: Well, it's okay.
I can set you free now.
TITANIA: I didn't want you to do something stupid just because of me--
Just because I'm cold-hearted, and made a mistake, and the cost sunk more every day.
What was I supposed to do?
I thought if I told you, or even if I just rejected you in the first place--
That you would go over the deep end, and--
AMARIA: Well,
Maybe you were right.
TITANIA: Amy, wait--
TITANIA: \PN,
I'm going after her, but I don't have a way back up.
Figure it out.

You know, it's one thing that she found out about my facade and tried to off herself.
But I was actually glad to have that shackle lifted off of me.
And now, everything that we just went through has been completely voided by her losing her memory.
And I'm stuck again.
